title: pkix-identity: eight survivors left, two of them unkillable
description:
## Why

pkix-identity's sweep: 164 mutants, 27 missed, 19 closed. These eight are
what is left.

## The survivors

    lib.rs:116:9    replace _assertions with ()

Unobservable, same class as pkix-chain's `_verifier_is_send_sync`: a
compile-time assertion block whose obligation the build discharges.

    lib.rs:485:33   replace || with && in MailboxName::parse

Equivalent. `local_raw.is_empty() || domain_raw.is_empty()` is refused again
downstream by `validate_ascii_local_part` (empty local-part) and
`normalize_dns_name` (empty domain), so no input distinguishes the two
forms. Recorded in the commit that closed the rest of the function; left
in place as redundant defence rather than deleted.

## The rest

Six survivors remain unexamined at the time of writing -- the sweep list is
in the session scratchpad under mutants-pkix-identity/. Re-run the sweep to
regenerate it:

    cargo mutants -p pkix-identity --all-features -j 4 --timeout-multiplier 4

pkix-identity has one non-default feature (`serde`), so `--all-features` is
the right scope; a default-feature run would report the serde shims as
survivors spuriously (see AGENTS.md, "Name the features when running a
mutation sweep").

## Found by

The pkix-identity mutation sweep, 2026-11-27.
